async def act(page):
    # Check if the Project name textbox already has the correct value, and fill if not
    textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name")
    current_value = await textbox.input_value()
    if current_value != "Not an interesting site":
        await textbox.fill("Not an interesting site")
    # Wait for the Save changes button to become enabled
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes").first
    await save_button.wait_for(state="enabled")
    # Click the Save changes button
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for any navigation or state change after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
